title: Fix lint_issues.py: broken project root and missing unknown-field check
description:
lint_issues.py has two bugs:

1. **Broken project root**: `Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent` resolves to `scripts/`, not the project root. It looks for `scripts/issues/` which doesn't exist, so the linter silently returns no errors. The entire linter is a no-op. Fix: use `.parent.parent.parent` or find the project root another way.

2. **No unknown-field check**: Even once the path is fixed, the linter only validates required fields. It doesn't reject unknown field names. This allowed the delete-blog-pages issue to use `"autograbbable": false` instead of the correct `"not_autoclaimable": true`, silently bypassing the autoclaim guard. Add an allowed-fields set (REQUIRED_FIELDS + known optional fields like `not_autoclaimable`) and error on unrecognized keys.
